correctness.rationale: For Haar U on S^2, center chord L=2 min_i a_i/|U_i|. Inclusion-exclusion of three absolute-coordinate spherical caps yields F=Σ(1-2a_i/x)_+-ΣJ, because no triple intersections occur before x=2R. The joint two-coordinate density is 1/(2pi sqrt(1-u²-v²)); integrating over quadrants gives the stated elementary J. Scaling the shrinking pair intersection gives positive coefficient 2 sqrt(r_ij)/(3pi a_i a_j) times (x-2r_ij)^{3/2}. For terminal tail U_i² follow Dirichlet(1/2,1/2,1/2), whose smooth density near a_i²/R² times a shrinking area δ²/2 yields R/(4pi prod a_i)*(2R-x)². Independent numerical evaluation of J against 1D spherical quadrature plus Gaussian-sphere simulation for a=(1,1.7,2.4) gave errors under the expected sampling tolerances. Coincident thresholds are handled termwise.
